    In-house Product Inventory

    Products you keep in stock at the center. A ✔ appears after the product name in every visit and quick visit while it is available. Stock reduces automatically when a visit uses “In-house stock”. Inventory is private and never printed.

    Product Catalog & Prices

    Set your selling price and Direct Volume Points (Direct VP per unit) once – they pre-fill every new plan and invoice. Orange = not set yet. Direct VP is private: it is never printed on client invoices. Direct Volume Points are the points of orders placed through your center – orders clients place from their own Herbalife account are not counted here.

    Health Center & Coaches

    Center Logo (shown on reports, invoices, estimates, ID cards, the lock screen and the top bar)
    No logo
    JPG or PNG. A square logo on a plain or transparent background looks best.
    Center Stamp (printed at the bottom centre of customer reports, invoices, estimates & progress reports, and half over the photo on the Coach / Center Director ID cards)
    No stamp
    Stamp the center seal on plain white paper and upload a photo or scan. The white background is removed and the ink colour is kept.
    Center Director (printed on coach ID cards; also has its own ID card)
    No photo
    Portrait photo on a plain background. It is cropped to passport shape automatically.
    No signature
    Sign on plain white paper and upload a photo or scan. The white background is removed automatically.
    Coach % = the discount the coach gets from Herbalife on MRP (what they pay the company). Retail profit = this % − the discount given to the client. Example: bought at 50%, sold at 35% → profit 15% of MRP.
    Coaches
    Coach ID register (record of every coach ID issued, renewed or removed)

    Coach Identity Card

    Front and back come on one A4 page at actual card size (54 × 86 mm). Take it to a print shop for PVC card printing, or print on thick paper and laminate.

    Business Card

    Standard 90 × 50 mm cards, 8 to an A4 sheet. With a back side, the back sheets print after the front sheets - print them on the reverse of each front sheet. Print at 100% scale on thick card stock (250-300 GSM) and cut along the light edge lines, or give the PDF to a print shop.

    Active on their own

    Preferred Members and above can order products, follow an exercise schedule or track their health (KARADA) without visiting. Recording this marks them active again and takes them out of Slipping away / Dormant. It is not counted as a visit or a sale.

    🎨 Theme colour

    Pick any colour. Buttons, the header, tags, active tab and the estimate total line will change together. Saved on this device only.

    Tap the swatch for the OS colour spectrum, or type a 6‑digit hex code (3‑digit shorthand also works).

    🎁 Log a referral

    Record a friend’s number. When they visit and buy here, the referrer earns 10% of everything we earn from them (products, fees, membership, shakes) for a full year.
